## Headline — the content leaks, not just the clock

The 09/16 read said "pace + confirm-don't-guess." These two papers add a clear **content** signal on top of
that: nearly every question he got **wrong or flagged** is one of three topics —

1. **Coordinate geometry (circles & the plane)** — his single most repeated miss.
2. **Differentiation / stationary points** — "find the turning points, then reason."
3. **Range / max–min of rational & trig functions** (the $y$-as-parameter method).

Two brand-new clinics now cover exactly (1) and (2). Those are the next two sessions.
